population.period: Current revisions contained in the completed 2026-09-01 dated dump
population.variety: Collaboratively edited international English; no national-variety inference
structural_eligibility: retained prose contains 500 through 3999 project tokens
at least five prose paragraphs remain after the frozen extractor
population.rights_rule: Assign target-blind priority before page-level rights review. Only rights_status=pass may later enter a sample; hold/fail rows remain visible and replacement follows the next rank in the same length stratum.
population.target_exposure_rule: Every input row must remain unexposed to MWE search, dictionary lookup, model prediction, annotation yield, and downstream outcomes. Any other state fails closed rather than becoming an exclusion reason.

candidate_input.format: UTF-8 JSON Lines, one metadata object per page revision
forbidden_content: MWE forms, matches, labels, or counts
participant, comprehension, gaze, or other downstream outcomes
candidate_input.exact_schema_rule: Extra or missing fields fail closed so target-derived variables cannot silently enter selection.

selection.design: Stratified simple random sampling without replacement, implemented as a deterministic pseudorandom permutation within each length stratum
selection.hash: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON [frame_id, seed, page_id, revision_id]
selection.order: Ascending selection hash, then page ID and revision ID, independently within each frozen length stratum
selection.inclusion_probability: For a frozen allocation n_h and N_h rights-pass rows in stratum h, each rights-pass row has first-order inclusion probability n_h/N_h; structural or rights fail/hold rows have probability 0. Values remain unresolved until source materialization and IR-127.
selection.prefix_rule: After IR-127 freezes allocation, take the first rights-pass, still-unexposed rows in each stratum; a non-pass row is replaced only by the next queue rank in that stratum.
selection.no_post_target_replacement: After any target exposure, a failed selected document remains an exposed exclusion and cannot be silently replaced in the same sealed sample version.

current_boundary.claim_ceiling: population, eligibility, strata, seed, ranking, and replacement procedure frozen; no sampled document or benchmark exists

Run scripts/sample_benchmark_documents.py to create deterministic per-stratum priority queues.
Complete page-level rights review in queue order without target search.
